chunks: Whatever is in Hāʾ from Ṣāliḥ ibn al-Ḥakam, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Ṣāliḥ ibn al-Ḥakam al-Aḥwal.

key_terms.الْأَحْوَلِ: al-Aḥwal; an identifying epithet for Ṣāliḥ ibn al-Ḥakam
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: may Allah be pleased with him; honorific supplication for the narrator’s father
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration
key_terms.عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ: from Ṣāliḥ ibn al-Ḥakam; the named transmitter to whom this chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of al-Ṣadūq to Ṣāliḥ ibn al-Ḥakam in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Ṣāliḥ ibn al-Ḥakam al-Aḥwal in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission and preserving the source-chain for hadith scholarship.
